title: DO VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS RESPECT CONTEXTUAL INTEGRITY IN LOCATION DISCLOSURE?
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (VLM-GEOPRIVACY) focused on privacy and contextual integrity in the context of image geolocation. While it utilizes a philosophical framework of privacy ethics (Contextual Integrity Theory) and references human social norms, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or general moral/ethical reasoning.
